product: An operations console for a regional field-service company coordinating technicians, jobs, delays, and customer escalations.
audience: Dispatchers and operations managers who use the interface all day.
primaryTask: Identify the highest-priority issue and reassign work without losing surrounding context.
constraints: high information density with clear priority hierarchy
motion only for state and continuity
no marketing hero treatment inside the application
mobile should prioritize queue and task detail rather than shrink the desktop workspace
